plugin.name: Compact_Pheal
plugin.author: Zargulis
plugin.description: Compact Pheal ------- Reduce pheal spam Type 'cpheal help' for usage

muclient.aliases:
<alias match="cpheal\s(?(on|off))" regexp="y" enabled="y" sequence="99" script="cpheal_alias" />
<alias match="cpheal timer\s(?(on|off))" regexp="y" enabled="y" sequence="99" script="timer_alias" /> <alias match="^cpheal timer\s(?(\d*))$" regexp="y" enabled="y" sequence="100" script="set_timer_alias" /> <alias match="^cpheal pacman\s(?(on|off))$" regexp="y" enabled="y" sequence="100" script="pacman_alias" /> <alias match="^cpheal sound\s(?(on|off))$" regexp="y" enabled="y" sequence="100" script="sound_alias" />
<alias match ="cpheal test\s(?(on|off))" regexp="y" enabled="y" sequence="100" script="test_alias" />

trigger.name: prefresh_capture
trigger.match: feels less tired after your refreshment

trigger.name: sheal_capture
trigger.match: A warm feeling fills your body

muclient.script:
require 'aardwolf_colors'
function cpheal_set() EnableTriggerGroup("cpheal", cpheal_enabled)
if cpheal_enabled then EnableTimer("pheal_timer", timer_enabled) EnableTrigger("pheal_end", not timer_enabled) print ("Cpheal is enabled.") else EnableTimer("pheal_timer", false) EnableTrigger("pheal_end", false) EnableTrigger("blank", false) -- ??? EnableTrigger("full", false) -- ??? print ("Cpheal is disabled.") end end
function pacman_next_blank() EnableTriggerGroup("pacman", pacman_enabled) end
function init() pheal = 0 prefresh = 0 sheal = 0 srefresh = 0
timer_enabled = GetVariable("timer_enabled") or true timer_enabled = tostring(timer_enabled) == "true"
timer_seconds = tonumber(GetVariable("timer_seconds")) or 3 SetTimerOption("pheal_timer", "second", timer_seconds)
pacman_enabled = GetVariable("pacman_enabled") or true pacman_enabled = tostring(pacman_enabled) == "true"
sound_enabled = GetVariable("sound_enabled") or false sound_enabled = tostring(sound_enabled) == "true"
cpheal_enabled = GetVariable("cpheal_enabled") or true cpheal_enabled = tostring(cpheal_enabled) == "true"
test_mode = GetVariable("test_mode") or false test_mode = tostring(test_mode) == "true"
cpheal_set() timer_info_alias() end
function colorsToAnsiNote(data) return AnsiNote(ColoursToANSI(data)) end
function cpheal_alias(name, line, args) cpheal_enabled = args.cmd == "on" SetVariable("cpheal_enabled", tostring(cpheal_enabled)) cpheal_set() end
function timer_info_alias() status = "" if timer_enabled then status = "enabled" else status = "disabled" end
print("The timer is " .. status .. " and set for " .. timer_seconds .. " seconds.") end
function timer_alias(name, line, args) timer_enabled = args.cmd == "on" SetVariable("timer_enabled", tostring(timer_enabled)) EnableTimer("pheal_timer", timer_enabled) EnableTrigger("pheal_end", not timer_enabled)
if timer_enabled then print("Cpheal timer on. Prompt display off.") else print("Cpheal timer off. Prompt display on.") end end
function set_timer_alias(name, line, args) if tonumber(args.seconds) ~= nil and tonumber(args.seconds) > 0 then timer_enabled = true timer_seconds = args.seconds SetVariable("timer_enabled", "true") SetVariable("timer_seconds", timer_seconds) timer_seconds = args.seconds EnableTrigger("pheal_end", false) EnableTimer("pheal_timer", true) SetTimerOption("pheal_timer", "second", timer_seconds) print("Cpheal timer set to: " .. timer_seconds .. " seconds.") else print("Must be in the form: cpheal timer <seconds > 0>") end end
function pacman_alias(name, line, args) pacman_enabled = args.cmd == "on" SetVariable("pacman_enabled", tostring(pacman_enabled)) if pacman_enabled then print ("Cpheal pacman will eat blank lines between received pheals.") else print("Cpheal pacman no longer eats blank lines between received pheals.") end end
function sound_alias(name, line, args) sound_enabled = args.cmd == "on" SetVariable("sound_enabled", tostring(sound_enabled)) if sound_enabled then print("Cpheal pacman waka-waka!") else print("Cpheal pacman no waka-waka...") end end
function help() print("Compact Pheal") print("cpheal help") print("cpheal on/off -> [default on]") print("cpheal timer -> displays timer status") print("cpheal timer on/off -> toggles timed display/prompt display [default timer on]") print("cpheal timer # -> enables and sets the timer [default 3 seconds]") print("cpheal pacman on/off -> toggle eating blank lines between received pheals [default on]") print("cpheal sound on/off -> toggle waka-waka [default off]") print("cpheal test on/off -> displays omitted lines to see what it's doing [default off]") end
function test_alias(name, line, args) test_mode = args.cmd == "on" SetVariable("test_mode", tostring(test_mode)) print("Cpheal test mode: " .. args.cmd) end
function pheal_trigger_capture(name, line, args) if test_mode then print(line) end pheal = pheal + string.match(line, "%[(%d*)]$") end
function prefresh_trigger_capture(name, line, args) if test_mode then print(line) end prefresh = prefresh + string.match(line, "%[(%d*)]$") end
function sheal_trigger_capture(name, line, args) pacman_next_blank() if test_mode then print(line) end sheal = sheal + string.match(line, "%[(%d*)]$") end
function srefresh_trigger_capture(name, line, args) pacman_next_blank() if test_mode then print(line) end srefresh = srefresh + string.match(line, "%[(%d*)]$") end
function pheal_trigger_end() report = ""
if pheal > 0 or sheal > 0 or prefresh > 0 or srefresh > 0 then report = "@w<< In: @G[@W".. sheal .. "@G] @w| @C[@W" .. srefresh .. "@C] @w>> << Out: @G[@W".. pheal .. "@G] @w| @C[@W" .. prefresh .. "@C] @w>>" colorsToAnsiNote(report) pheal = 0 prefresh = 0 sheal = 0 srefresh = 0 end end
function blank_trigger(name, line, args) if test_mode then print("pacman ate: " .. line) end if sound_enabled then PlaySound (1, "waka-waka.wav", false, 0, 0) end end
function OnPluginInstall() help() init() end
